title: Techno-Economic Assessment of Shared PV and Battery Energy Storage Systems under Spanish Residential Collective Self-Consumption
subtitle: A Simulation-Based Case Study in Seville, Spain
author: Raphael Omonzokpia Demilade
purpose: Machine-readable context for GitHub Copilot and other LLM coding assistants. The canonical LaTeX source is preserved without content replacement.
research_questions: RQ1: Under what conditions does a shared BESS provide incremental value over a PV-only configuration?
RQ2: How much value is attributable specifically to the battery, and how is it affected by the monthly compensation cap under RD 244/2019?
RQ3: How sensitive are the results to PV penetration, battery CAPEX, electricity prices, community size, and participant composition?
regulatory_context: Spanish residential collective self-consumption under RD 244/2019, with participant-level monthly simplified compensation and no carry-over.
